guide_solution: Matching (a) + (vi) Khan Jahan Ali's Bagerhat is beset with various problems. (b) + (v) He built numerous mosques in Bagerhat. (c) + (iv) The Shat Gambuj Mosque is the most magnificent of them. (d) + (iii) It was used both as a prayer hall and a court of Khan Jahan ali.
